cevap.question: bu yıl makine bazında oee
cevap.sql: SELECT makine AS makine, (1.0*SUM(calisma_suresi_dk)/NULLIF(SUM(planli_uretim_suresi_dk),0)) * (SUM(performans_PV*planli_uretim_suresi_dk)/NULLIF(SUM(planli_uretim_suresi_dk),0)) * (1.0*SUM(uretim_kg - hatali_kg)/NULLIF(SUM(uretim_kg),0)) AS ort_oee FROM oee_vardiya WHERE tarih >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1
cevap.planned_sql: WITH oee_vardiya AS (SELECT "wren_src_oee_vardiya".makine AS makine, "wren_src_oee_vardiya".tarih AS tarih, "wren_src_oee_vardiya".uretim_kg AS uretim_kg, "wren_src_oee_vardiya".calisma_suresi_dk AS calisma_suresi_dk, "wren_src_oee_vardiya".planli_uretim_suresi_dk AS planli_uretim_suresi_dk, "wren_src_oee_vardiya"."performans_PV" AS performans_PV, "wren_src_oee_vardiya".hatali_kg AS hatali_kg FROM (SELECT oee_vardiya.calisma_suresi_dk, oee_vardiya.hatali_kg, oee_vardiya.makine, oee_vardiya."performans_PV", oee_vardiya.planli_uretim_suresi_dk, oee_vardiya.tarih, oee_vardiya.uretim_kg FROM (SELECT __source.calisma_suresi_dk AS calisma_suresi_dk, __source.hatali_kg AS hatali_kg, __source.makine AS makine, __source."performans_PV" AS "performans_PV", __source.planli_uretim_suresi_dk AS planli_uretim_suresi_dk, __source.tarih AS tarih, __source.uretim_kg AS uretim_kg FROM boyahane."main".oee_vardiya AS __source) AS oee_vardiya) AS "wren_src_oee_vardiya") SELECT makine AS makine, (1.0 * SUM(calisma_suresi_dk) / NULLIF(SUM(planli_uretim_suresi_dk), 0)) * (SUM(performans_PV * planli_uretim_suresi_dk) / NULLIF(SUM(planli_uretim_suresi_dk), 0)) * (1.0 * SUM(uretim_kg - hatali_kg) / NULLIF(SUM(uretim_kg), 0)) AS ort_oee FROM oee_vardiya WHERE tarih >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1
cevap.calculation_explanation: Bu değer oee ölçüsünün 2026-01-01 tarihinden itibaren makine bazında kırılımıdır (toplam/ortalama).
